audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Lillia's Q "Blooming Blast" in six places, and attributes true damage to her passive.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Q is Blooming Blows (450 range, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s) and the true damage is on its OUTER EDGE, not on the passive. The passive, Dream-Laden Bough, deals additional max-health damage over time. The page also says she out-ranges you at level 1 — her Q is 450, exactly your Mortal Steel; the range that actually beats you is Swirlseed at 700.
audit.corrected: Real name everywhere, true damage moved to the Q edge, max-health burn to the passive, and Swirlseed named as the poke that out-ranges you.
sources: packet suspectNames: wrote 'Blooming Blast', looksLike 'blooming blows'

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 3, 4-5 and 6 contradicted the whys sitting under them — Yone at 3 and 4-5 against "a skill dance" and "stays even", Lillia at 6 against "coin-flip", and Skill at Level 2 against "you punish her the moment her Q is down".
audit.why: Packet chart reads Lillia, Yone, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yone, Yone and every one of those rows matches the existing why text.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Yone, rows 2, 3 and 4 to Skill on BOTH layers as one group, phase whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.late both say Fate Sealed "sets up team knockups nothing can dodge", and no cooldown for Lilting Lullaby appears anywhere.
audit.why: Fate Sealed is a PULL — it blinks behind the last champion in a line and drags everyone hit toward Yone. It is not a knockup, so it does not set up knockup-dependent ults. Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110s, and it only sleeps enemies who already carry Dream Dust.
audit.corrected: Corrected the pull in both fields and put 120s / 150s side by side in phases[4].why; report[5].t now states the Dream Dust precondition.

edits.before: After your first item the matchup swings your way for good. notes: 'Blooming Blast' is fabricated — the ability is Blooming Blows, and the packet's suspectNames caught it. Two related mechanic errors travelled with it: the true damage sits on the Q's outer edge (not the passive, which is max-health damage over time), and her Q is 450 range like yours, so nothing about it out-ranges you — Swirlseed at 700 is the poke. Fate Sealed corrected from 'knockup' to a pull in two fields.
